purpose: Loss-free GT-conditioned diagnostic measuring whether each predicted patch could accept any pixel-level GT label present in its 8x8 footprint.

inputs.prediction_labels: One integer [16,16] predicted instance-ID map from the frozen prediction provider.
inputs.pixel_ground_truth_labels: Integer [128,128] CLEVR mask; patch allowed sets include every ID present in the 8x8 pixels, including background ID 0.
inputs.majority_target: Existing clevr_mask_patch(mask,8).patch_labels; modal pixel ID with ties resolved to the smallest ID.

algorithm.candidate_compatibility: Use candidate GT ID 0 for predicted background, otherwise the one-to-one mapped GT ID. Count acceptance only when that candidate belongs to the patch's pixel-GT allowed set. A rejected candidate resolves to the original modal 8x8 GT label; therefore a predicted background patch on a pure-object footprint remains foreground in the resolved target.
algorithm.matching: Sort non-background predicted groups by first row-major occurrence, sort non-background GT IDs numerically, and use deterministic rectangular Hungarian matching. Integer objective weight is the number of patches in that predicted group whose allowed-label set contains that GT ID. No epsilon is added to break ties; stable row/column ordering is the tie rule.
algorithm.unmatched: Every unmatched or zero-overlap predicted group receives its own unique negative sentinel, which cannot belong to an allowed GT set.
algorithm.resolve: For every patch including predicted background, use the candidate ID when it is allowed; otherwise use the existing modal 8x8 GT label. Assert every resolved label belongs to its patch's allowed set.
algorithm.score: Compute the existing patch_fg_ari(predicted_labels, resolved_target_labels). Report under the explicit name allowed-label oracle FG-ARI (one-to-one membership matching); it is GT-conditioned and is not exact permutation-invariant ARI optimization or a standard model metric.

diagnostics: Per-image oracle score with valid flag; undefined (<2 resolved foreground patches) is serialized as null, not NaN.
All-patch acceptance rate and accepted/total patch counts.
Original majority-GT and resolved-GT foreground patch counts.
Number of target patches changed by resolution.
Per-predicted-group assigned GT ID or unique sentinel, first patch index, and membership-overlap count.
constraints: Loss-free post-prediction analysis only; scorer does not alter predictions, source metrics, model, classifier, training, or selection gates.
Original fg_ari, foreground_iou, and matched_object_iou remain unchanged and are reported separately by the frozen prediction provider.
No input mutation; predictions remain 16x16 patch labels and are not expanded to pixels.

evaluation_contract.ours: SW0097 positive_frozen seeds0/1/2; compare recomputed original metrics per image against each registered evaluation.json to 1e-10 before interpreting oracle scores.
evaluation_contract.matched_slot: SW0092 Slot-on-our-70k epoch-10 seeds0/1/2; preserve its original metrics and verify recomputed means/counts against immutable evaluation_summary.json.
evaluation_contract.released_slot: Also report the single released Slot checkpoint separately. Its training data differs and it is not a matched three-seed 70k baseline.
evaluation_contract.prediction_checks: Validate all six matched ours/Slot prediction tensors, IDs, source/checkpoint/gamma hashes and evaluation summaries before opening masks. Released Slot prediction and protocol are separately hash-checked before masks are opened.
evaluation_contract.ground_truth: Only after prediction checks, read masks[1320:1640] from the canonical CLEVR HDF5. GT is never used to produce or select predictions.
evaluation_contract.output: Write new summary.json atomically only when output path is absent; include original metrics and per-image oracle diagnostic records.
